raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-15 CRM migration brought in customers whose region is a numeric code ('01'-'04') rather than a name, and silver_customers only applies upper(region), so the codes pass through unmapped. raw_region_map maps each code to a region name one-to-one (4 distinct codes, no duplicates), so joining it in silver_customers with a fallback to the existing value resolves the codes without changing the table's columns or row count.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
